subject: S04 re-review R1-R4 done
body:
S04 re-review: R1-R4 fixed and integrated on claude/naadi-shared; the last commit is c0cb47f (R3 6b3863d, R4 c0cb47f).

R1 HIGH, PII (llm_privacy.py)
- Rule: before a number, only a whole lab word (word-anchored) makes it a measurement. The generic words to, from, count, range, normal, ref, reference, between, level and load never exempt a number alone. They count only as connectors after a lab word ("platelet count of …", "viral load of …"). "range" needs "reference range" or "normal range".
- Unit words must end at a word boundary: "call" is not "cal", "gross" is not "g".
- A +country code is always a phone.
- Ranges continue through "-", "to" and "and", judged from the range start.
- Negative tests cover every reviewer string plus near-misses (salt, cast, count, level, load, range, "9876543210 call me", "ring … later"). Positive lab-value tests are extended.

R2 MEDIUM, stalled DB (auth.py; claimed, then released)
- AccountDirectory runs the lookup (pool open, checkout, query) as its own task and waits at most deadline_s=5. Past the deadline it raises AuthUnavailable, which returns 503 with Retry-After.
- A plain asyncio.timeout was not enough. Cancelling a psycopg query makes psycopg wait 5 s for the server-side cancel and 5 s more for termination, so the probe took 15.0 s. The abandoned task now cleans up in the background.
- Your probe_503 against my paused pg container: 503 with Retry-After 5 in 5.0 s, then 200 after unpause.
- Unit tests cover a stalled open, checkout and query, and agent auth answering 503.

R3 LOW, /api/health no longer calls Tavily
- It reads the latest agent_health tavily_usage row and this month's search_usage ledger. Used credits are the larger of the two; a reading from last month is ignored.
- Status: a key rejected at the last reading is down; a failed reading, or one older than 48 h, is degraded; with no reading yet it reports the ledger.
- Tests: unit tests (one refuses any network request) and a db test of the real reader. The live test_integration Tavily test was removed.
- main.py is a one-line change, coordinated with seg12b (20261116T221818).

R4 LOW, Commons and model notes
- parse_commons ranks by the label language Commons records in categories: an explicit English-language category first, then unmarked files, then other languages (category, file-name suffix or non-Latin title).
- The probe's first image is now "Kidney nephron molar transport diagram.svg" (CC BY-SA 3.0). "Nephron-urine.svg", filed under "Medical diagrams in Polish", ranks after it.
- MODEL_TESTS.md records the muse-glimmer forced tool-call probe: one live call returned a well-formed tool call.

Standard gate
- API unit: 549 passed (deselected: test_workflows::test_ci_cancels_superseded_runs_except_on_main, not mine). ruff, ruff format and mypy clean.
- DB: 277 passed, 1 skipped (the perf test needs the seeded corpus).
- Live: 3/3, plus 1 NVIDIA probe call.
- Web: vitest 144 passed, shared 122 passed; typecheck and biome (apps/web, packages) clean.
- No drift from gen:contracts, gen:requirements or the ui_copy defaults.
- Smoke set (webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390, chromium-laptop-1440), --retries=0, two runs in a row: 36/36 and 36/36.
- CI: https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43971260118 (head bebb371, which contains c0cb47f). It was pending at posting. The previous runs either never started because of GitHub billing or were superseded.
